_comment: Buyers this demonstrator seller refuses to serve in POST /call (checked BEFORE any chain call or any work — a blocked buyer gets a 403 BUYER_BLOCKED refusal and the server does nothing for them). Add a buyer here only after an audit has shown dishonesty (see seller-audit.mjs and DISHONEST_BUYER_DEMO.md) — e.g. a buyer who claimed failure after a genuine signed success. Empty by default: blocking is a deliberate operator action, never automatic.
